about.name: Dayan Candamil
about.h1: A private gateway to the UAE.
about.body1: Puerta Dubai is a buyer-side investment concierge for global HNW families entering the UAE — real estate, business setup, banking, tax, Golden Visa and relocation handled under one desk. Founder-led, small by design, the desk takes a limited number of mandates each year so every relationship runs in person.
about.body2: Dayan's background spans law, branding and luxury cultural ventures across Europe, Latin America and the Gulf. The desk works in five languages and routinely coordinates with international counsel, family offices and developer principals on behalf of clients who do not live in the region full-time.
about.body3: Sourcing off-plan and secondary inventory, due diligence, payment plans, escrow, mortgage introductions, company formation, residency, banking — the same point of contact walks each step. No handoffs, no junior account managers.

About.metaDescription: A private gateway for global investors entering the UAE market.
About.heading: One platform. Complete access to the UAE.
About.body1: Puerta Dubai is a private investment-concierge gateway for high-net-worth foreign investors entering the UAE — combining real-estate acquisition, business setup, tax and legal structuring, banking coordination, Golden Visa processing, and relocation under one roof.
About.body2: The desk is founder-led and intentionally selective, coordinating each mandate through one trusted point of contact across property, residency, banking, and relocation.

Founder.metaDescription: Senior investment strategist and cultural entrepreneur. Cross-border advisory between Latin America, the GCC, Morocco, and West Africa.
Founder.bio1: Dayan Candamil sits at the intersection of capital and culture. As Associate Partner at BlackOak Real Estate, he leads international markets and structures cross-border investment flows between Latin America, the United States, the GCC, Morocco, and West Africa — originating complex transactions across prime land, luxury residential, and branded developments.
Founder.bio2: Trilingual across English, Portuguese, and Spanish, he advises developers on market entry, investor positioning, and pricing frameworks, while serving as Creative Director of House of Candamil — the Bogotá-rooted atelier behind couture-quality accessories and ready-to-wear shown internationally.
Founder.positioningBody: A bridge between international private capital and the developers, sponsors, and operators building the next decade of prime real estate across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Casablanca, and the West African coast.
Founder.strategistBody: From originating prime-land transactions to advising on investor positioning and distribution across Latin American and African markets, Dayan manages high-value transaction pipelines and strategic partnerships — acting as the connective tissue between developers and the international private-client and family-office capital backing them.
Founder.journeyHeading: A career arc across capital and culture.
Founder.journeyIntro: Fourteen years of building and advising at the intersection of luxury, hospitality, and real estate — across Bogotá, Miami, Panama City, Casablanca, and Dubai.

GoldenVisa.metaDescription: UAE Golden Visa overview — eligibility, real-estate thresholds, residency benefits. Copy is gated on legal review.
GoldenVisa.heading: Long-term UAE residency, structured properly.
GoldenVisa.body: The UAE Golden Visa grants 5- or 10-year renewable residency to qualifying investors, entrepreneurs, and specialists. Real-estate investors qualify at AED 2,000,000 in property ownership per UAE federal portal and GDRFA Dubai guidance.
GoldenVisa.legalNote: Public copy on this page is gated on counsel review before production. Numbers shown here are the canonical UAE references — any concierge offer must be reviewed independently.
GoldenVisa.eligibilityBody: Real-estate investor (≥ AED 2M), entrepreneur, specialised talent, executive, scientist, outstanding student. Each route has documentation and processing differences. We confirm fit before any commercial conversation.
GoldenVisa.renewalBody: Five- and ten-year terms, sponsor independence, household inclusion, tax-residency planning, and cross-border considerations are covered in the private brief — content is authored in Sanity per locale and gated on legal sign-off.
